info.title: Loadster API
info.description:
The Loadster REST API works with the same projects, scripts, scenarios, datasets, monitors, and load test results as the Loadster dashboard.

Authenticate with a personal access token from the Loadster dashboard, sent as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. A personal access token reaches only the endpoints in this spec. The trigger endpoints under `/s/` and `/t/` need no token, because the code in the path authorizes the request.

AI assistants can also reach Loadster through the MCP server at https://api.loadster.com/mcp, with OAuth or the same personal access token.
